claims.claim_text: Working class independence is needed in all spheres.
Opposition to all institutions that block working class power.
Struggle reveals enemies beyond the boss and landlord, including those who attack working class organization or attempt to steer it away from power.
Police departments are enemies of the working class.
The Democratic and Republican Parties are enemies of the working class.
Union officials who seek accommodation with capital are enemies of the working class.
Nonprofit organizations that co-opt and redirect social movement militancy are enemies of the working class.
The Republican Party opposes the working class.
Leaders of the Democratic Party hide their opposition to working-class power behind false acts of goodwill.
Leaders of the Democratic Party publicly advocate policies said to reduce harm.

The real goal of those in control of the Democratic Party is to manage capitalism more efficiently, as an alternative to replacing it, as expressed in their relationship with Goldman Sachs and other capitalist institutions.
Paternalistic harm-reduction schemes of those in control of the Democratic Party can never replace, and will often decay, working class power.
Working-class institutions must be built to transform society.
